string.text: Su Lan
Sir Vitomir
A Suspicious Peddler
My name is Sonadel. I'm helping my parents, who are blacksmiths.
But lately, I've been getting tired of it. It's my wish to see the wider world.
Although my father didn't teach me smithing, I know a little bit!
I've taken charge of trading and managing the store instead of my parents. I'm sure I can be of help.
Those experiences are also useful in the party.
You still seem inexperienced.
If possible, I would like to work in your party. I secretly made my sword for a day like this!
I enjoy the days of being by your side on the battlefield and hammering alongside you in the forge. Do you feel the same?
I made this sword for you! I was wondering when to hand it over, but I think now is a good time. My sword will be by your side and help you cut down your enemies!
She is the blacksmith's daughter, who appears timid but is ambitious. Her parents appreciate her help in their work, but they recognize her ambition and hope to keep her out of the forge.
I'm Anette...
I joined a group selling goods in the town with my parents and the village's permission.
But then a war broke out, and I couldn't go back.
When I returned, the village was in flames, and that's why I'm here now.
That's truly unfortunate.
It's a common occurrence in these times.
To be honest, I have nowhere to go. Although I haven't learned any special skills beyond handling farming tools, I'm ready to work hard to learn.
I've gained much more experience in this short time than I did when I was helping with farming. It's a bit overwhelming, like suddenly riding a very fast horse, but it's enjoyable in its way.
I believe the training you gave me has paid off. I think I'll be useful in battle now. And of course, I can handle special weapons well, too...
She was an ordinary girl who liked to occasionally sell things in town. Now she must learn to survive in the world.
My name is Qiana. I was a girl from an ordinary peasant family.
But my father couldn't overlook the many injustices between duty and distribution, and just like that, our ordinary days ended.
I had to learn to survive in the wild. My father sometimes brought back food from places I didn't know.
One day, while I was sleeping in the cave, there was a loud commotion, and my father suddenly kicked me out, handing me a bow and arrow.
I can guess what happened...
I was wondering where it smelled.
I've managed to survive so far, but I don't want to walk the same path my father did.
All I had was hunting skills before. But I'm glad it helped you.
[if:convo_thinking][ib:demure]I remember tracking and hunting animals with my father to survive. Back then, I didn't want to go, but lately, it feels like I'm just waiting for the next hunting day...
She is the daughter of a resistance leader who fought against the lords who exploited the peasants and turned them into serfs. She was targeted for elimination by her enemies, but she survived.
I know it sounds weird, but listen.
I think I was in this world before but I have a faint memory.
I don't care anyway, but there are some people who remember me for some reason.
But the problem is not only that, but I don't remember everything.
Oh, I hope you can remember.
You're just saying you don't have any skills.
I think I'll get used to it soon if you help.
If I remember, I didn't have anything when I joined the party. I think it's amazing that you accepted me like that.
If you don't remember and start to remember all of a sudden, you remember several things at the same time, right? I think that's the time.
She thinks she was originally in this world. Not sure if it's true or false.
My name is Belladona. Sadly, I was kicked out of my village.
I accidentally gave the villagers something else instead of the herbs I was supposed to use.
But it's not my fault! The group of girls my age who were jealous must have set me up.
Suddenly, rumors spread that I was a red-haired witch, and I had to run away before the witch hunt began.
Everyone can make mistakes.
I bet you have a big cauldron in your house.
I know how to distinguish and handle herbs even though I haven't learned them formally.
I hope you don't push yourself too hard for the sake of others. Since you won't listen to me anyway, I'll always keep some herbs just for you.
[if:convo_relaxed_happy][ib:hip2]I think I've discovered a new herb! This medicine works especially well on an attractive poison like you... I'll cure you right now.
She loved to devote herself to her studies in her little cabin in the woods. The nickname 'red-haired forest woman' was enough to spark people's curiosity.
I used to work at the inn in the next town.
However, the inn started having more and more customers, and the workload became overwhelming.
I didn't realize it at first, but before I knew it, the inn was being called the Big Linda Inn.
Then, I happened to find it less enjoyable, so I decided to quit.
What if there's something more fun?
Well, are you saying you had fun during that time?
I have enough money to eat for now, so I might consider traveling if you have any suggestions for a little more money.
It's lively here. It's much better than dealing with drunks. Of course, if someone surprises me for no reason, I'll whip them with my horse whip.
[if:convo_pondering][ib:hip2]You once gifted me a fine horse. At that time, my pride was a little hurt. Because I am already quite fine myself... I have to prove you wrong now...
She was a maid who worked at the inn and in its stables. The inn became famous because of her, but she couldn't handle the fame.
My name is Adrianne, and my father, a woodcutter, taught me how to chop wood with an axe.
Later, it turned out, my father didn't learn how to use an axe by cutting down trees.
My father had many enemies around him. He was eventually killed one day by them.
Before they killed my father and stormed my house, I held my father's axe.
So you got your father's revenge?
I guess you didn't use your axe just for cutting down trees, either.
No, I prepared for a fight, but somehow they didn't attack me. I guess they thought their revenge was over. I was kicked out of my village instead.
I thought I might be following the same path as my father. But if I can be sure that my weapon is being used for a just cause, then I'm on the right path.

Um... you want to ask, what is this money? The weapon you gave me as a gift the other day was truly amazing. But someone stole it. I found the culprit, but he had already sold it. So I took a little revenge and came back...
She is the daughter of a father who was a ruthless warrior but was merciful to his family. The nickname 'Legendary Blood Axe' now remains only a legend. Or is this just the beginning?
My name is Laura.
My parents are engineers who build large structures.
They started a new project in this town, so I'm here, too.
Meeting you must be the beginning of a new job for me. I can and should do my part now.
I think it's a good opportunity for me, too.
I doubt you can do your part...
I learned engineers, but I was also in charge of procuring the necessary items for my parents' business.
Now I'm telling you, I missed an ingredient the other day, so I was afraid it would break down at a critical moment. Because you were there.

I've been hit by collapsing building materials before. Since then, my head has felt a little blank, and I think my parents didn't want to include me in their projects. But with the helmet you gave me last time, that won't happen anymore.
Her family are engineers who travel with caravans and receive commissions from villages and towns. Her family is known for their meticulous workmanship.
I think you've at least heard of my clan's name.
I already have a lot to eat at home, but I don't understand why my parents keep trying to push me out.
So I was forced to come outside by my parents to see the world.
Are you running a party by any chance?
Um, I don't need a princess.
I hope the party I'm joining has enough resources to keep us well-fed.
I've almost died several times already, and my parents would freak out if they knew I was going through all this. Maybe they'll tell me to come home right away.

Hey, honestly, you're short on money right now, right? I'd like to give you some of the money I've saved for situations like this. I saved up for it, but it was mostly pocket money that my parents gave me.
Her family is famous for being a family of great merchants that has been passed down from generation to generation. She lived a life almost like that of a noble.
People in my hometown don't feel the need for engineering at all.
I like to shoot arrows on horseback, but I'm also interested in researching and producing them.
I came here to study because it's hard to study like this near my house.
But it's hard to make money here, so at this rate, I have to quit quickly and go back.
I think you can achieve the things you want together.
Why don't you just follow what your family tells you to do?
Anyway, I need work. Even more so if it's something I can gain experience with.
I don't know how lucky I am to meet you. Not in my family. Maybe if it wasn't for you, I'd go back home and cut the wool.
I'm excited to be able to work as an engineer so soon. I'll do my best in your party.
A passionate engineer, she travels to find her path. She is also skilled in horse archery, which she learned as a child.
I was a caravan guard, but I had to run away after meeting a large band of bandits.
I followed their trail and reported it to the lord, but he didn't care.
So I had no choice but to go to a hideout to save those caught alone and come back injured.
Our caravan is gone, so I don't know what to do.
You're a very responsible person.
So you're saying you've been running away?
I'm good at tracking enemies and I know how to deal with horse-riding weapons.
Sometimes I think of a mission I failed in the past. I will no longer run away; I'd rather fight alongside you and be captured together.

We once attacked a bandits' hideout. There was a place I mentioned before where I went alone and failed. When it succumbed to your power, I knew something bad had happened to my former comrades. I'm glad you showed me justice even now.
She is a scout and warrior. Although she is responsible, she also believes it is important to protect herself.
I learned medicine from surgeons and South area's scholars.
But in recent years, there's been a lot of wars, so we have all been called somewhere, and so have I.
After going through several caravans to and from the village, I've ended up too far.
Now, I want to work in one place, not just a wandering.
You seem to have studied a lot.
It depends on what you do.
I've learned not only medicine, but also the trading skills of caravans.
The leader here is too tough. Always leaving everyone behind and going first by oneself. So I've gotten used to treating injuries. That's why I'm concerned for you.
[if:convo_pondering][ib:hip2]I told you that I didn't want to run the caravan anymore, but last time you put me in charge of the caravan... I'd like to work next to you, but could you do me a favor?
She received an elite education rarely found in medicine. She is a great healer and merchant.
I've never stopped fighting since I was a kid.
I had to survive these chaotic times and I learned sword and archery.
Right now, I'm doing anything that makes money.
Would an introduction be enough?
I shouldn't have asked.
I don't like talking about myself.
There were dramatic moments, but every time I just wielded my weapon as my leader instructed. I feel lucky to have a leader who can lead me like this.

[if:malfoy_custom_face][ib:weary2]On the battlefield, I charge under the command of the captain, and when I come back with a wound, I receive special treatment from the captain... Today, I think the wound is a bit deeper this time. Can you take a look at it?
She escaped from a village ruled by conquerors. She has been through a lot of fighting to survive her pursuers.
I left my village a few years ago. But my mercenary life with my dad was more suitable for me.
Even in the group where my dad was, I was recognized for my skills, but there was a problem with a shameless woman.
She kept framing my dad behind his back for not following. I got angry and asked for a duel, but I lost.
As soon as the defeat was confirmed and she insulted me, her neck was suddenly cut off in front of my eyes. Dad was a gentle person, unlike me, so I was surprised.
He put up with the slander of himself.
It looks like that impulsiveness runs in the family.
We ended up being kicked out. Dad found a new wife in the meantime and settled down in a village. But I find this life more interesting.
This must be I was looking for. I'm happy because I'm doing what I want to do. Might become like my dad later, but not now.
After working as a mercenary, I was appointed as the commander of a clan's party! I think I've achieved something, don't you? I'll brag to my dad later.
She lost her hometown due to war. Her family is famous for being a famous mercenary father and daughter.
There's nothing as foolish as introducing myself here by saying, 'I am a nobleman.'
But that's how I will introduce myself. It's only a lack of wealth, but I won't lack pride.
I do have the goal of restoring the glory of my clan.
Anyway, my eldest brother remains in charge, and I, well, let's say it's easy to understand if I say I'm on a business trip.
You haven't abandoned your ideals.
You want to be treated like a noble?
I understand my current situation well. I'm not a clueless fool. And, I've hardly ever experienced noble treatment.
I believe each type of person can do different things. You're quite different from my scholarly older brother. This approach suits me better.
You founded a new kingdom not long ago. I heard from my brother that the reconstruction of our clan is nearly complete. I believe our clan can aid the kingdom.
He is the second son of a fallen noble clan. Although he left to restore the glory of the old clan, there are rumors he fled to escape the burden of his fallen clan.
I was a personal guard for a lord.
So, there is a place I should return to.
Oh, please don't misunderstand me as a deserter. My last role was to be a decoy so my lord could escape safely.
So I'm a person who should be dead, captured, or simply does not exist.
You were a soldier faithful to your duty.
But shouldn't you return? The lord likely had no choice.
I was ready to die, but I didn't. It seems the one who tried to survive wasn't as lucky. If I had somewhere to return to, I would have gone long ago.
If you've made, or are going to make, difficult choices, I hope you'll be honest with me. I'm not afraid to do my job, but I'm afraid of doing something unjust.

Recently, when we fled from combat, it was uncomfortable because I remembered the past. Perhaps it was the right decision, but those who experienced it might have preferred to die honorably in battle.
He is a soldier with natural leadership and combat skills. Despite his limited experience, he has served as a guard for a lord.
I'm a hunter, but it's not just for gathering food.
It's a hunt to solve problems. You can call me a bounty hunter.
Wild boars and wolves, which often attack farms and homes, are my main targets.
I accidentally captured an animal that a noble valued. I'm taking a break from work until the situation calms down.
Did you not go hunting on a commission? If so, there wouldn't have been a problem.
The difference between a hunter and an illegal poacher isn't that significant.
I think I've been caught in someone else's trap. I'm a problem-solver and didn't want to create problems.
So I'm unsure if I've helped solve your issues by coming here. But if you ask me, I'm glad to be here with you.
You appointed me as your scout. I want to commend your judgment. My experience and skills will surely be useful.
He is a hunter who tracks down troublesome animals. There are rumors he possesses dragon teeth, but that is likely an exaggeration.
The marriage proposal has been accepted!
It can only be done inside the settlement.

Request a conversation
{Hero} has come to visit you.
There is something to talk about.
Tell me the story you told me when we first met.
It's been a while since you joined the party.
I want to present you with the honor of winning the tournament today.
I want to become a little closer to you.
It doesn't matter. I don't care about that.
Well, come to think of it, I almost made a mistake.
Why don't we talk about the future together?
(Waiting for an answer.)
Can you tell me what it is? You might change your mind.
Let's discuss this again later.
(Here I begin my wedding to her.)
Maybe we can meet again later.
What do you think about me?
This isn't a problem. Soon you will like me too.
What we lack is the trust that comes with a long period. Although the time we met was short, the trust we have gained so far will not be betrayed.
Marriage is a union between individuals, but it is also a union between families.
I wanted to spend time with you, but I didn't have time. Because I'm doing what I need to do.
Did you feel that way? So, let's talk little by little starting today.
But I think I have what you're looking for.
I am attractive because I'm an elite warrior.
It's not usually visible on the outside, but at important moments when everyone is agitated, everyone will be looking at me.
Love is just a fever. Realistically, choose a path that allows you to live comfortably.
You will discover my other charms somewhere.
With my experience running caravans and workshops, I can make money quickly.
So I need you more. I think you can solve this problem.
With my blacksmithing skills, it's easy to make money quickly...
I am good at discerning the difference between money and important things. Soon you won't have to worry too much about it.
Money can come and go. Right now, it's just a temporary setback.
There are many people who like me and support me. If things continue like this, we will be able to quickly increase our reputation.
There are still few soldiers following us, but we are fighting systematically and efficiently. These victories will quickly raise our reputation.
You like me, and I like you! Then it's done!
I have a home. There, we can lay the foundation for our clan.
The world just hasn't recognized us yet.
Our clan has a great reputation. I'm sure someone will acknowledge us and we can receive land.
Even if I don't have a home right now, I'll only choose the best inns for you.
At least I can help you stay healthy while we're out.
I thought you were used to this kind of life.
You'll start missing the days when you could roam outside.
I think we need to end this relationship.
This is the conclusion I've come to after thinking it over.
Nevermind, I'm just wondering what happened to me for a moment.
Can we get along like we used to?
I feel the same way.
That proposal is not acceptable.
I was injured in a recent battle.
I think I'll recover faster if you treat me yourself.
That might be helpful.
I need more treatment time than before.
I was able to recover faster because you treated me yourself.
Now that I think about it, I just need some simple herbs.
You seem to be injured.
Can I take a look myself?
Then make sure to rest well for next time.
No, in this case, need more rough treatment.
I'll do whatever you want.
I think it would be better for you to just rest today.
Blacksmithing is always tough work.
But I still have stamina left for other tasks.
You're right, I should get some sleep.
You're making too many demands on someone who's exhausted from work...
Right, so I'd like you to fill a bit.
No, I just need to get some sleep.
Our party is running low on food.
I'll tell the others that you and I are going hunting.
Let's take as many people as possible for the hunt.
There isn't much to hunt today... I'll have to focus on one.
I think we should do that today too.
We'll soon be able to get food from the surrounding settlements.
I think you need weapons training.
That's all for today's training.
I'm thinking of doing some extra training today...
Yes, it's going to be rough practice today.
Special weapons should be handled carefully.
It looks like you have something on your mind.
Well... we'll do it another day.
Let's see if you can persevere mine...
Prove it.
How long have we been together?
So what brings you here?
How dare you! You haven't fulfilled your duties as a wife!
You're right, I'll show you the weight of my responsibilities.
The support of the nobles will benefit the kingdom.
We'll talk about this again next time.
Yes, Captain?
I hope we can talk like today more often.
Tell me anything, my love.
Thank you for your interest in my story.
[if:convo_bemused]You mean that for me? I appreciate it.
[if:convo_thinking][ib:nervous2]Oh... I was just surprised because it was a little sudden. I'm not sure yet because I've only been here for a short time.
[if:convo_bemused]I'm glad you said that. I also wanted to know more about you. I'll do my best for this relationship.
[if:convo_thinking][ib:closed2]But you already have someone with you, right?
Okay, why not? I should get a chance to be with you too.
[if:convo_pondering]No, I won't do that. I don't want to make that kind of relationship.
[if:convo_thinking][ib:demure]I've thought about that too.
I think we still need to get to know each other better. I hope you're not rushing into things.
I'm excited about the future with you, but I have some concerns that are holding me back. I'm not quite sure...
[if:convo_bemused][ib:hip2]To be honest, I've been waiting for you to bring that up!
I think weddings can be held in a castle, town, or village. We can have our ceremony wherever we choose.
Let me share some of my concerns...
You're someone who others generally like, but we haven't been very close.
Honestly, I don't feel a strong attraction to you.
I don't think we have enough resources to maintain our clan's reputation.
I think our clan's reputation should be a little higher than it is now.
It's fine now, but it would be better to have a place to unwind when things get tough.
Well... I see...
[if:convo_bemused][ib:hip2]I think you're right. I've decided to trust you and be with you.
I think it would be a good idea to talk about this again after we go through the things you said one by one!
[if:convo_bemused][ib:hip2]Honestly, what you say doesn't seem convincing. But I just decided not to worry about that.
I'm not entirely sure why, but I do feel hesitant. I would like to discuss this further next time.
Hmm... I haven't thought of anything specific yet. I hope I can respond more confidently next time.
It's been quite a while since we've been together. I'm glad to spend this time with you.
I appreciate your kindness. I also want to show my gratitude.
I can't deny that you're an attractive person.
You lead a promising clan. I truly admire your qualities as a leader.
You have something special that I wish for someone. I like that about you.
[if:convo_thinking][ib:weary2]But you're already married to someone else. You know we can't go on like this.
[if:convo_pondering][ib:hip2]I heard you're getting close with another woman. I'm disappointed that you do that even though I'm with you.
[if:convo_pondering][ib:hip2]You're not cheating on me with another woman, are you? I hope I heard wrong.
[if:convo_thinking][ib:weary2]Congratulations on your marriage, but I'm so sad that you married someone other than me.
[if:convo_pondering][ib:demure]I need to tell you something. I think it's becoming too difficult to maintain our relationship.
[if:convo_thinking][ib:demure]Um, do you really think we should end our relationship?
[if:convo_thinking][ib:nervous2]Are you serious about that? I'll do better, so I hope you'll reconsider...
It's unfortunate, but I guess this is the limit of our relationship.
Oh no! Please don't leave me...
[if:convo_pondering][ib:hip2]I was surprised. I hope you won't do that again next time.
[if:convo_thinking][ib:weary2]I don't think that's right. Just leave me alone for now.
[if:convo_thinking]... All right. But I don't want to get hurt again.
[if:convo_pondering][ib:demure2]... Captain, I have something to share with you.
I was thinking that I want to get closer to you, Captain. If that's okay with you...
[if:convo_bemused]I promise I will become someone worthy of you, Captain.
Oh... I'm sorry...
[if:convo_thinking][ib:demure]You have a wound. If you use this herb, it will help you heal quickly.
I don't think it's that serious of a wound. I don't think nursing is necessary.
Then, let's slowly check the wound in my room.
[if:malfoy_custom_face]Do you need my treatment today as well?
[if:convo_thinking][ib:weary2]It's because of recent events. If I take time to rest, I will recover.
Oh, you don't have to worry so much. It's not that serious.
[if:convo_bemused][ib:weary2]Okay, then I'll stop by your place today.
[if:malfoy_custom_face][ib:weary2]Last time, the treatment was too rough. Can I ask you to be gentler today?
[if:convo_confused_normal][ib:weary2]Oh, please don't do that.
I watched you sweat so hard. Let's take a break for a moment.
I hope you aren't overworked. I've prepared a place for you to rest.
[if:malfoy_custom_face][ib:hip2]Then, please show me your ‘remaining stamina'...
[if:malfoy_custom_face]Oh, are you lacking stamina? I think I can help you recover a bit.
[if:convo_relaxed_happy][ib:hip2]You'll have to use all your stamina on me!
So should we hunt even the animals around us? I'm ready.
The more people there are, the more food we can gather. It would be better if we leave together.
I don't think there's a need to inform anyone else. I'll just quietly pack my equipment and come back here.
[if:malfoy_custom_face]So, are we going hunting today too? Although it seems like I am the prey.
[if:convo_relaxed_happy][ib:hip2]It looks like you've already finished the hunt and it's time to enjoy it, but let's go hunting anyway.
What kind of training are you thinking about?
Okay, I'll follow you as soon as you teach me.
[if:convo_thinking][ib:confident2]If it's important training, I'll do it with other colleagues. I think special classes just for me are unfair.
What kind of weapon needs extra training?
[if:malfoy_custom_face]Should I still train today on how to handle your special weapon?
